news.title: Nakoda Group of Industries Limited Appoints Apurv Hirde as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective April 16, 2026
news.body: Nakoda Group of Industries Limited appointed Mr. Apurv Hirde as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the company with effect from April 16, 2026. Mr. Apurv Hirde is an Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India having membership no. A60955 possessing requisite qualification and skills in secretarial compliances and has undertaken assignments and has good experience of Corporate Law and Listing Regulations. Mr. Apurv Hirde is not related to any Director of the company.

news.title: Nakoda Group of Industries Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 60.9 million in funding
news.body: Nakoda Group of Industries Limited announces a private placement to issue 8,700,000 Convertible Warrants at a price of INR 7 per warrant for gross proceeds of INR 60,900,000 on April 16, 2026. Warrant Exercise price is INR 21. No CTRL Enterprises LLP, Equirise Advisors LLP, Vishal Mahesh Waghela, Onvo Aquarrius Private Limited, Sarthak Goyal, Preet Khetan, Vinod Premsukh Khetan, Sunil Tripathi (HUF), Agrawal Commercial and Juhita Hardik Shah acting as investors.
